comments.text: Mam i have a request please tell about the definition of pre existing deases as pre IRDA guidelines & in this plan 3 more features are available that anybody can choose 4,3 or 2 year waiting period for ped and 1 Or 2 year waiting period for specific illness. Zone wise premium discount & co payment with zone wise is applicable but anyone can take zone 1 premium even if he is living in zone 3 to abolish zone wise co payment and most interesting part is that if a person take policy on floater basis and want to add his parents or parents in law he can add and the premium is applicable to the age of proposer unlikely other plans which have highest age of family person or insured. 🙏🙏
comments.author: @abhilashkumarkedia3268

comments.text:
Abhilash jee, 

Answering your queries below:
1. A pre-existing illness means any health issue that the person has been facing prior to purchasing a health insurance policy. The pre-existing conditions include all the health issues ranging from high blood pressure, thyroid, the usual suspects like diabetes, asthma, etc.

2. Yes, zone 1 premium can be paid even if you are in zone 2 or zone 3, no address proof is required for zone 1

3. Yes, premium is calculated at the proposer's age even if parents are added in the policy

Hope it helps!
Thanks
